freeze.effective_condition: exact manifest merged into main before this candidate's economic results are read
freeze.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',', ':'); allow_nan=false
freeze.identity_change_policy: any strategy, universe, sample, cost, or gate change requires a new candidate_id and Owner approval

universe.selection_basis: fixed ex-ante multi-sector SHFE/INE day-session universe with existing product-spec contract fields; no economic result was used

account_and_target.margin_breach_policy: HOLD_CASH and retain the rejected opportunity in the frozen denominator

time_contract.night_session_assignment: the exchange-assigned next official TradingDay, even though this candidate does not trade night sessions

pit_contract_mapping.decision_source: completed official day D all-contract settlement and open interest panel
pit_contract_mapping.eligibility: delivery month later than D calendar month; finite positive settlement and open interest; valid exact-contract LTD and spec
pit_contract_mapping.ranking: open_interest descending, delivery_month ascending, exact_contract ascending
pit_contract_mapping.effective_time: next official TradingDay after D at 09:00:00 Asia/Shanghai

slow_state.availability: formed only after official day D settlement inputs are complete; first usable at the next official TradingDay day open

roll_safe_index.roll_day_return: log(settlement_D(M_previous) / settlement_previous_official_day(M_previous)); settlement_D(M_D) only anchors the next interval
roll_safe_index.missing_or_non_finite_policy: slow_direction=0; no skipped day and no forward fill

carry.far_contract: F_D is the eligible exact contract with the earliest delivery month strictly later than M_D
carry.c20: arithmetic mean of the 20 consecutive official-day daily carry values ending at D

direction.flat: all other cases, including zero, missing, stale, or non-finite input

bar_contract.source: exact-contract 1-minute bars derived from real exact-contract events
bar_contract.alignment: each official day-session segment is partitioned independently from its published start
bar_contract.completeness: all 15 scheduled one-minute components must exist and be final; otherwise the scheduled 15-minute bar is missing
bar_contract.missing_bar_policy: no signal decision; no forward fill and no lookback skipping
bar_contract.ohlc_authority: exact-contract only; continuous-main and synthetic bars are diagnostics only

entry.long: slow_direction=+1, flat, and completed 15-minute close is strictly greater than the maximum high of the immediately preceding 20 scheduled complete bars of the same exact contract
entry.short: slow_direction=-1, flat, and completed 15-minute close is strictly less than the minimum low of the immediately preceding 20 scheduled complete bars of the same exact contract

exit.long: completed 15-minute close is strictly less than the minimum low of the immediately preceding 10 scheduled complete bars of the same exact contract
exit.short: completed 15-minute close is strictly greater than the maximum high of the immediately preceding 10 scheduled complete bars of the same exact contract
exit.slow_state: exit when the next effective slow_direction is flat or opposite
exit.maximum_holding: exit after the final eligible bar of the fifth official TradingDay, counting the fill TradingDay as day one

candidate_rule.earliest_reentry: first eligible signal on the next official TradingDay
candidate_rule.opposite_state_transition: close first; a new opposite entry is eligible no earlier than the next official TradingDay
candidate_rule.terminal_unfilled_exit: remain an explicit open exposure and retry only at the next real eligible quote; never invent a terminal fill

roll_semantics.trigger: effective M_D differs from the exact contract currently held
roll_semantics.action: close the old exact contract before opening the new exact contract in the unchanged target direction
roll_semantics.execution: each leg uses its own real side-aware BBO, fee, tick, multiplier, latency, and impact
roll_semantics.failed_close: do not open the new leg
roll_semantics.filled_close_failed_open: remain flat with an explicit unfilled target opportunity
roll_semantics.new_contract_entry_warmup: 20 scheduled complete 15-minute bars are required for a non-roll fresh entry

same_as_candidate: fee, latency, spread, and impact model
paired_next_open_baseline.entry_and_transition: when the slow target changes, submit at the first legal day-session BBO after the next official TradingDay 09:00 eligibility time
paired_next_open_baseline.holding: hold the slow target until it becomes flat or opposite; no 15-minute trigger, exit, or re-entry rule
paired_next_open_baseline.purpose: measure only the incremental after-cost effect of the intraday timing layer

quote_and_fill.qualification: finite non-crossed positive BBO for the exact contract, required side volume >= 1, within exchange limits, and event_time at or after eligibility time
quote_and_fill.session_end_search_window: first 300 seconds of the next legal day-session segment
quote_and_fill.partial_fill_model: none because target size is one lot; insufficient side depth is UNFILLED
quote_and_fill.missing_or_stale_policy: UNFILLED and retained in the frozen denominator; never use bar close, next bar open, mid, synthetic quote, or forward fill

cost_scenarios.fee_requirement: historically effective exact-contract fee schedule keyed by exchange, product, effective TradingDay, and OPEN/CLOSE/CLOSE_TODAY offset; unknown or zero-assumed fee is forbidden
cost_scenarios.roll_cost: two separately charged and impacted legs

excluded_known_history.use: coverage diagnostics only; economic scoring forbidden because related-family history may already have been observed

strict_unopened_holdout.access: sealed until development results and independent causal review are final

future_economic_gates_not_authorized_by_.paired_increment: for each instrument, candidate primary after-cost net profit / abs max drawdown must exceed its paired baseline; higher turnover alone is a failure
future_economic_gates_not_authorized_by_.temporal_reporting: each development fold, long, short, roll, top-day removal, and every frozen opportunity
future_economic_gates_not_authorized_by_.holdout_and_forward: require separate Owner authorization; passing does not grant shadow or SimNow authority

stage_boundary.current_stage: P0 design freeze plus P1 data sufficiency only
